name: NotebookEdit
description: Replace the source of one cell inside a Jupyter `.ipynb` notebook. The cell is located by `cell_id`; its `source` is replaced with `new_source`. For code cells, `execution_count` resets to null and `outputs` resets to an empty array (mutated code cells have stale output). Insert and delete edit modes are deferred to a later wave — this tool accepts only `edit_mode: "replace"` (the default).

notebook_path.description: Absolute path to the .ipynb file to edit

cell_id.description: Id of the cell to replace (the `id` field inside the notebook's `cells[]` entry)

new_source.description: New source content for the cell

cell_type.description: Optional cell type (`code` or `markdown`). If provided, must match the current cell type — type conversion is deferred to a later wave.

edit_mode.description: Edit mode — only `replace` is supported in this wave; `insert` and `delete` return InvalidArgs
